paper.title: Barriers to Counterfactual Credit Attribution for Autoregressive Models

claims.paper_statement: A next-token (0,0)-CCA predictor can fail sequence-level (epsilon,delta)-CCA.
claims.scope: Exact finite-state Theorem 4.2 construction over 42 declared epsilon/delta cells; not a formal universal proof.

claims.paper_statement: Autoregressive rollout CCA can require more than the per-token guarantee suggests.
claims.scope: Finite-support path certificate plus independently generated branching trace audit.

claims.paper_statement: Approximate CCA retrofitting requires exponentially many black-box queries.
claims.scope: Exact Section 5 hard-family LP and decision-tree cells through marked-string length 7; asymptotic conclusion remains paper-level.

claims.paper_statement: Direct next-token CCA does not guarantee autoregressive CCA.
claims.scope: Consequence of the exact C1 rollout counterexample; no separate model or training claim.

official_code.note: The source audit found no author executable; repro/ is clean-room code.

publication_policy: Publish the finite construction audit with explicit formal-proof, asymptotic, model, and empirical limits; do not assert a score or author endorsement.
